label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Rick, I'm putting this in a text because if I call you I'm going to yell.

I'm not calling Denise. You gave her my cell without asking me, so you get to tell her it's not happening.

You told Gary I'd list his house for 1%. I have never said 1% to anybody, ever. My listing side is 2.5%. You made up a "family rate" for a guy who isn't family and handed it out like it was yours to give. Then I spent my whole Saturday on it. I pulled comps, drove down to Chandler from north Phoenix, did the walkthrough, and printed a full listing packet. Six hours plus the drive. Sunday night Gary texts me he's going with ListLite for $3,995, "no hard feelings." And when I called you about it I got "that's business sis, can't win em all."

That wasn't business, Rick. I didn't pick that listing, you did, and I worked my Saturday for free so you could look like a big shot to your buddy. I'm honestly not even that mad at Gary. He took the cheapest deal, people do that. I'm mad at you.

And it's not the first time. Same thing happened with your softball guy two years ago. I let it go then, and that was my mistake, because now you're lining up the next one before I've even cooled off from this one.

So this is how it works from now on. You don't give out my number. You don't quote my commission, not 1%, not any number. If somebody you know wants to sell, you ask me first, every time, and I decide if I take it and what I charge.

And don't tell me I'm being stingy. Mom, your kids, actual family, I'll help with anything and the advice is always free. That hasn't changed. But your coworkers and your softball team don't get a family rate, and they sure don't get one I never offered.

I'm pissed and I'm going to be for a few days. I'll still be at your place for Thanksgiving. I just needed you to hear it straight from me.
